Our Beginnings

We have grown by continuously reflecting on what we create and how we advance.
Every step of our journey has led us to where
we stand today.



Every step along our journey has held its own meaning and value.
Today, the world seeks not only WHAT we create and HOW we create it, but also
the WHY behind it all.
This shift highlights
the new challenges of our time


The question of  "WHY"
has never been more important.
Our Beginnings

We have grown by continuously reflecting on what we create and how we advance.
Every step of our journey has led us to where we stand today.



Every step along our journey has held its own meaning and value.
Today, the world seeks not only WHAT we create and HOW we create it, but also the WHY behind it all.
This shift highlights the new challenges of our time


  1. The question of  "WHY" has never been more important.


Why We Need New Questions
In a rapidly changing world, we now stand before new questions.
Now, we must ask WHY?
Our Purpose
WHY = PURPOSE

In an era of instant answers, unseen choices, overwhelming connectivity,

and uncertainty, the answer we must hold
onto is WHY—our PURPOSE.


WHY is the simplest yet
most fundamental compass

we have to respond to the
challenges of our time.

A Shift
FROM HOW TO WHY

Until now, we have pursued growth with
HOW at the center.

Now, in balance with WHY, we must seek deeper meaning and clearer direction. 


When WHY takes the center,
the HOW becomes even clearer.

Mastery of HOW

Through WHAT and HOW, we have achieved rapid progress and countless human achievements. However, today’s challenges cannot be fully addressed by these methods alone.

The Need for WHY

In an age of instantaneous answers,
predetermined choices, overwhelming
connectivity, and uncertainty,
we need deeper meaning
and clear direction to move forward
with purpose.

A Shift in Balance

When WHY takes the center, the HOW becomes even clearer. In this balance,
our achievements gain deeper meaning
and sustainability.

WHAT IS YOUR WHY

This is a question for all of us to ask.

Our Method
 ASK, SHARE, CREATE

WHY:2025 is more than a conversation—

it is a shared process of
asking, sharing, and creating.


These three actions lead us to discover
and expand our WHY

2025 : Forum Theme
 WHY: 2025

Our First Step Together

Our journey toward WHY begins with Mindset.
The Global and Design Mindsets shape
how we see the world
and how we connect with one another.


Together, they reveal the first step of
our journey toward WHY.

A mindset is never complete on its own.
It grows deeper and stronger when we
listen, share, and grow together.

WHY:2025 is a place to explore and share
these mindsets collectively.

Opening Remarks & Keynote Address
Leadership Embodied by the City: Designing Change


The inaugural session of the WHY:2025 Forum is dedicated to 'Design Leadership,' exploring new paradigms of leadership that connect the city with its institutions, policies, and citizens. We will examine how leadership, at the intersection where administration, industry, design, and citizens meet, can actively shape a 'City of Creativity and Inclusion.'

SE-HOON OH

Mayor of the Seoul


Vice-Chair & Steering Committee Member

C40 Cities Climate Leadership Group

Visionary strategist positioning Seoul as
Asia’s Design Capital and climate leader

HYUN-SUN KIM

Chair, Korea Federal Design Association


Chair of DDP (Dongdaemun Design Plaza)

President of KHSD (KimHyunSun Design) 

Creator of urban-color identities that define
Korea’s design landscape. 

CATHY LEE

Professor, IDAS  Hongik University

Design Management


Global Network Director, 30th KFDA Anniversary

Cross-Cultural Expert & Leadership Mentor

Member of Scientific Council of the MFI (CNMI)

SESSION 1.
GLOBAL MINDSET
An Open Attitude to the World: Leadership that Learns and Grows Together 


The second session of the WHY:2025 Forum is dedicated to 'Global Mindset,' exploring the common values of leadership formed across diverse backgrounds and cultures. We will seek to chart a course for leadership that learns from and grows alongside the world, built upon attitudes of diversity, inclusion, and collaboration.

JENNY MING

Rothy’s CEO

Founding President, Old Navy

Iconic retail leader now coaching global executives in purpose-driven leadership and brand growth.

EUN MEE KIM

UN Women National Ambassador

President, Ewha Womans University

Scholar-diplomat advancing inclusive development and leadership in higher education.

SØREN VESTER HALDRUP

UNDP Global Policy Centre for Governance

Policy Advisor

Applies design thinking to complex public-sector systems.

SESSION 2.
DESIGN MINDSET
Perspective Transformed by Thought: Redesigning the World with Human Sensibility


The final session of the WHY:2025 Forum is dedicated to the 'Design Mindset,' exploring how creative thinking and a human-centered sensibility fundamentally redesign the relationships among the world, organizations, and society.

ENRIQUE MARTINEZ GONZÁLEZ

Founder and President of Muchieast

Strategic Designer, Former Government Innovation Advisor
Drives human-centered policy and civic-service innovation.

SIMON GEOFFREY LOASBY

Senior Vice President, HMG

Head of Hyundai Global Design Center

Leading global design leadership and innovation through harmony of emotion and culture.

KEN NAH

Board Member, World Design Organization

As a WDO board member

he advances global design leadership and innovation.

in the power of inquiry, discussion,
